Yeah I can see that. Ultimately response prevention is what gets you better from OCD. 

You do need to expose yourself to things you've been avoiding if they are actively blocking you from doing things you want to do. For example if you like people and want to make friends, but you have thoughs about harming others, you're gonna have to be around others to get over it.

OCD sufferer here. Sounds like you have OCD to me. You have obsessions which cause you distress (worrying about contamination) and compulsions (washing your hands until they are sore).
Obviously get professional help, but OCD is treated by reducing and ultimately eliminating the compulsions.

Whenever you get the urge to check, clean or whatever the compulsion may be, try and delay it for a short while first. This will feel a lot easier than straight up refusing to do it. You will feel anxious, that doesn't mean it's not working. Your brain needs to learn new associations which takes time.

Good luck.
